text:
noah: Quick ask from marketing: before we finalize the blog and webinar, can runtime produce a tiny reproducible bench pack we can cite? Need to back up two bullets about latency and streaming tradeoffs.
sana: Sure. What does "tiny" mean exactly?
noah: Minimal artifact: per-request CSV, manifest with model checksum & exact run command, short README, and a 1-slide PNG with p50/p95/p99 bars. Also include 6 token-level traces (sampled).
eli: Which model/quant/hardware?
noah: Use model-marketing-v1 (I'll DM the checksum), h100-medium, fp16 and int8 variants. Short demo: 256 tokens @ 60qps. Long demo: 2048 tokens streaming @ 8qps. Warmup: 3 windows then steady-state. Seed: mkting-seed-2026 (sana will drop the seed file).
tegan: Do you want both streaming and non-streaming runs for long context? Streaming tends to lower the initial tail but can shift p99 slightly.
sana: Yes include both and label them clearly. Also capture cache-hit rates and a note if prefix-caching is active.
eli: We will produce: artifact.tar.gz containing manifest.txt, per_request.csv, token_traces_sample.csv (6 rows), README.md (with an explicit reproducible command), and pxx_chart.png. We'll annotate whether runs were coldstart vs warmed.
noah: Please add one sentence in README: "single-run smoke; expect variance +/- 10% on p95 due to scheduler and cache effects."
qa-runner: Job queued: 120411 on h100-medium. Expected smoke runtime ~1h. Will post GCS link when finished. runtime-bot: job 120411 queued.
tegan: For the README reproducible example use this snippet so marketing can paste it directly:
```
MODEL=model-marketing-v1 CHECKSUM=sha256:placeholder RUN_SEED=mkting-seed-2026 ./bench/run_smoke.sh --qps 60 --tokens 256 --warmup 3
```
eli: If marketing wants a rerun at different qps or to include int4 (experimental), we can do a fast follow-up on a single variant.
noah: Timeline: need smoke artifact by tomorrow 9am PT to update slides. Full sweep can be later. Is that feasible?
qa-runner: Smoke ETA tomorrow 07:30 PT. Will upload to gs://redwood-marketing/bench/5112345678/smoke.tar.gz and post link here.
sana: Dropping the seed and payload list into #marketing-assets now.
runtime-bot: job 120411 completed: gs://redwood-marketing/bench/5112345678/smoke.tar.gz (3.8MB). Logs: gs://redwood-marketing/bench/5112345678/logs/120411.log
noah: Got it, downloading and will quick-verify. If copy tweaks needed I'll call out specifics. Thanks all :raised_hands:
sana: I'll sanity-check the manifest and confirm p95/p99 match the slide numbers. If we see >10% variance we'll request a rerun in this thread.
eli: Standing by for followups.
